newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Allstate to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Allstate to buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers raised its rating on Allstate Corp to buy from outperform based on long-term earnings growth potential and the recent 8.5 percent decline in share price.
-- Lehman set a year-end 1997 target share price of $75.
-- Allstate traded at 56-3/4, up 1-1/2, in early morning trading.
-- Lehman said it believes Allstate has $1.50 a share in excess reserves which should materialize in earnings over the next three to four years.
-- Lehman said Allstate's current valuation does not fully reflect expected share repurchase activity. Lehman expects Allstate to repurchase about 15 percent of its shares by the end of 1998.

-- Margin expansion, depletion of excess loss reserves and share repurchases will create earnings per share growth of 15 percent over the next several years, Lehman said. EPS growth should peak in 1998 at 17 percent.
